inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Thundercoast, a stormy coast ruled by a sea tribe of fishmen who build machines under the water and look down on everyone who breathes air, where everything in the sea is electric. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy. A war torn brutal planet where everything wants to kill everything, told with absurd deadpan humour. One whole region shown as one wide connected panorama, read left to right in three places: the storm beach, then the shipwreck shallows, then the tide gate. Bare at the left, more and more built up toward the chief's place at the right end. Every part continues into the next with the same light, the same horizon and the same floor; nothing is repeated.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright readable war torn battle stage with absurd deadpan humour, coherent pixel clusters, a real place with depth", "lighting": "Bright sun breaking through storm clouds from the upper left, wet shine on rocks and brass, cool teal shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the sand floor in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a3a52", "#4a6a8a", "#9ac4d8", "#e8f8ff", "#1a6a7a", "#2a9aa8", "#7ad0d0", "#1e2630", "#3a4652", "#b87a3a", "#e0a84a", "#ff7a3a", "#4a8a6a", "#9aa6a2", "#c2c8bc"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage panorama seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no people. The top part is sky above a distant horizon with the region's landmark. Behind the arena the scenery stands in overlapping rows at different depths, with one big set piece for each of the three places and low framing pieces in the near foreground. The lower part is one flat calm arena floor running the whole width.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 260, 1000], "desc": "a dramatic storm sky of dark slate clouds with bright breaks of sunlight, one jagged lightning bolt striking far away"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [143, 0, 442, 1000], "desc": "a churning teal sea with tall black sea stacks, and at the right end a colossal brass tide engine tower rising from the waves with lightning crackling around its top, the region's landmark"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [364, 0, 559, 1000], "desc": "behind the arena: wet black rocks, coral, rusted brass pipes and valves, glass tanks of glowing water, shipwreck timbers, kelp, sparse at the left and denser toward the tide gate"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [195, 92, 611, 242], "desc":
